record.title: SELECT durable learning R56 containment
record.body: Durable learning: when a reusable consumer-qualification workstream is exact-head ALIVE but stalled only by draft-state metadata, selection capital should remove that metadata fence and contain the capability rather than manufacture another parallel verifier. After containment, composition measurement that is already on default history becomes immediately actionable as a downstream multiplier, but cannot count as 1000X until independent consumer receipts exist.

metadata.lesson: remove metadata suppressors only after exact-head qualification; then expand independent consumers before claiming composition leverage
